title: Culture.
note: A petri dish half off the page, its colonies grown by simulation and seen from the air, with the data falling down the left like water.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] wrote a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion simulation in [[Python]] with [[NumPy]] that grows seven colonies on the plate, each with its own feed and kill rate, so one grows a maze, another spots, another a honeycomb. A [[WebGL]] shader lights them like agar on a light box, breathes them in a wave out from where each was seeded and scatters single colonies on the bare agar between, and the waterfall is drawn on [[Canvas]] in [[Google Fonts]] Inter Tight and IBM Plex Mono, every line horizontal, stretching as it falls.
keywords: halfway off the side of the page
